full.description: This image is a gross specimen photograph of a human brain viewed from the superior aspect, showing the cerebral hemispheres with prominent sulci and gyri. The meninges covering the brain surface appear congested and thickened with visible exudate or cloudiness along the blood vessels and sulci. These findings are characteristic of acute or chronic meningitis, such as cryptococcal meningitis, involving inflammation of the leptomeninges. The overall appearance demonstrates swelling and vascular engorgement indicative of an infectious or inflammatory central nervous system process.

random.description: This is a gross pathology photograph showing a human brain. The specimen displays diffuse opacification and thickening of the leptomeninges with visible exudate obscuring the cortical sulci. These findings are characteristic of leptomeningeal carcinomatosis or meningitis. The pattern indicates tumor cells or inflammatory exudate filling the subarachnoid space.
